description: Defines the HTMLPurifier_URI class which represents and validates URIs within the HTML Purifier library, including methods for normalization, validation, and string conversion.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URI
classes.description: Represents and manages the validation and string representation of URIs in the HTML Purifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a URI object with components, normalizing scheme and port.

methods.name: getSchemeObj
methods.description: Retrieves a scheme object for validation based on the URI's scheme or default.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and encodes URI components according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Reconstructs the URI as a string for output.
